notes: «عن ابن عباس، وعن جابر بن عبد الله الأنصاري، قالا» : the two Companions are co-transmitters of the first route

«ثم سألته بعد حين ... فأخبرني قال أخبرني جابر» is a second route through Ata to Jabir, written in full (example 3 pattern); the text breaks off before the saying, so this route is read on the strength of the same topic and flagged here
No «ح»; the groups repeat the names
